The process

Four stages, done by hand

  1. Step 01

    Brush & mesh

    A fine-bristle brush lifts dry dirt out of the mesh, the creases and the seams before anything wet touches the shoe.

  2. Step 02

    Material-specific clean

    Suede, leather, mesh and fabric each get their own treatment. Custom materials are handled on their own terms.

  3. Step 03

    Stitching & sole

    Seams, stitching and soles detailed by hand. Where stitching has opened up, it is re-stitched and re-finished.

  4. Step 04

    Condition & return

    Conditioning oil for leather, a clean dry finish for everything else — then picked up and returned to your door free.
